name: Apostle Paul
overview: The Apostle Paul is presented in Scripture as a devoted servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, called and set apart by God to proclaim the gospel of grace (Romans 1:1; Galatians 1:1). His ministry was marked by a steadfast commitment to finishing his God-given course with joy, despite personal hardships (Acts 20:24). Paul’s writings reveal his deep awareness of the struggle between the flesh and the Spirit (Romans 7:15), while emphasizing the power of God's grace working effectively through him to serve others (Ephesians 3:7). Additionally, Paul highlights the transformative reconciliation available to those once alienated by sin (Colossians 1:21).
